title: Owens' three-UFO-sighting experiment around San Francisco
place_text: within 100 miles of San Francisco (San Diego as control)

tellings.quote: I'm going to create three UFO sightings within a 90-day period within a 100 miles of San Francisco.

plain: In 1976 a man named Ted Owens, who claimed he could make UFOs appear, announced he would produce three UFO sightings within 90 days and within 100 miles of San Francisco, with San Diego serving as a comparison area. Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a doctorate in parapsychology, tells Michels he took part in the test, quoting Owens' promise: "I'm going to create three UFO sightings within a 90-day period within a 100 miles of San Francisco." If it worked, it would suggest a person's mind could call up UFOs on demand.
